title: 第3章 越狱进行时第4章 监狱逃脱
content_zh:
第三章越狱进行时
忽然郝宁身边传来泰德的质问声，他心中一惊连忙将手中的钥匙收了起来。
“我……我只是睡不着，想到处走走！”回头一看，只见泰德静静地站在他身后，紧紧地盯着他手中的钥匙。
“你在说谎！我从中午开始就一直注意着你，包括你那些神奇的魔法道具，使用的时候根本没有任何魔法波动，竟然能将波动掩盖得这么好。”
“虽然不知道你到底用了什么什么魔法道具，但是我可以确定的是你想要逃离这所监狱。如果我发出什么声响，外面的士兵一定会注意到里面的动静吧？比如让整个监狱闹起来。”
泰德说话时粗犷的脸上依然是非常严肃，这让郝宁从他的脸上根本看不出什么东西。
“我们的利益并不冲突吧？而且我还是一个盗贼，对于逃离的路线很擅长！”
他说得没错，那些骑士根本不是郝宁能够对付的，能够当上骑士这样的兵种，也该也有黑铁阶的实力吧！
这个世界的人可以分为青铜.黑铁.白银黄金这些等级，如果面对黑铁阶骑士，别说三个，就算一个来也能利索地干掉郝宁。
“这………好吧！我是想越狱！难道你是想我也带着你出去？不，这不可能，你根本不能快速跑动！”
郝宁微微叹了一口气，面对他的威胁，郝宁只好答应带着他离开，不然一闹起来，面对的就不是一名狱卒，而是无穷无尽的城卫军。
此时泰德粗犷的脸上隐约间浮现出诡异的笑容，一闪即逝。
“呵呵！刚刚你开门的应该是魔法道具吧？我只是想要你帮我
只见他转身把身后锁链上的铁锁露了出来，那是一只雕刻着符文的锁，一般是用来锁住一些重要犯人。
“金币！”
在听到金币的瞬间，郝宁感觉似乎快喘不过气来了，他的身体对金币似乎拥有无尽的渴望。
郝宁心中不禁暗骂一声，该死，这个身体简直就是一个该死的守财奴，怎么一听到金币就好像快死了一样。
“好……好吧！但是我不保证一定会成功。”
郝宁按照刚刚的方法把盗贼之匙对着那把锁，轻声念道：“使用盗贼之匙！”
整个牢房显得特别安静，手上的钥匙一点反应也没有。就在郝宁以为钥匙失去作用的时候，钥匙上传来一阵温热，而泰德身上的锁竟然自动脱落到地面。

嘭地一声！钥匙从他的手中炸开了！
“啊！”郝宁也被吓了一跳，想不到钥匙竟然会像鞭炮一样爆炸，不过好在他的属性提升了，不然刚刚那一下就能把他的手炸伤。
“这钥匙怎么炸了……明明还有一次使用机会的！”郝宁疑惑的看着手中的钥匙碎片。
“噹！噹噹噹！”泰德一下子把身上的锁链甩到地上，“太好了！这该死的锁链竟然封锁住我所有力量！”
“好吧，出去后，我会给你报酬的，既然你已经准备越狱，说说你的计划吧？”
“既然有你加入，我的计划就要改变了……”
…………
通道尽头的威尔听到牢房里面竟然传来钢铁的敲击声，好像是那两个新来的家伙所在的牢房中搞出来的。
大晚上的，这些该死的家伙究竟在搞什么！哼！让你们瞧瞧威尔我的厉害！
他带上自己制式长剑往通道上走去，他已经决心要好好教训一下这个新来的家伙了，让他明白这里的规矩。
“该死！你这个该死的家伙究竟在搞……什么……”
天呐，威尔不敢相信自己究竟看到了什么！
昏暗的牢房中，那个恶心的小偷犯人不知生死地躺在地上，而那个浑身绑着锁链的犯人竟然不见了！冷汗不停地从他的额头冒出，如果那个犯人从这个牢房逃走，毫无疑问威尔自己将会被送上断头台。
但是身为一名士兵，威尔并没有忘记战场上留下的教训，抽出腰间的制式长剑，双眼警惕地扫视着四周。因为威尔敢肯定，那个犯人绝对还没有离开这个地方！
“你在找我吗？”
威尔身后传来一把阴森森的声音，就像亡灵的呼唤一般。
一股巨力袭向威尔，噗嗤一声，他只感到脖子上一痛，漫天血雾占据他的视线。双眼中透露着无尽地恐惧，他想说话，但是喉咙仿佛破了一个洞，嘴里只发出嘶哑的吼声。
威尔不甘地捂着喉咙，鲜血不受控制地狂涌而出，他的眼神逐渐地开始暗淡起来，扑通一下软到在地。怨恨的双眼紧盯着泰德，他不甘心，他要报复这两个人，他要这两个人永远逃不出这个监狱。
一道身影从他的身边缓缓浮现，很随意地将手中匕首的血迹甩去。
那正是消失的泰德，在不引起任何注意的情况下，竟然这么简单就搞定了这个狱卒。

在不远处状死的郝宁也站了起来，眼神复杂地望着地上充满不甘的死尸。
看来他还是把杀人想得太简单了，这里不是游戏，杀掉的也不是一堆数据，但是郝宁即将面对未知的世界，在以后的道路中，杀人是不可避免的。
到那时候自己真的能下得了手吗？郝宁不由望了望自己轻微颤抖的双手。
“嗨！该走了，再这样拖下去，会被人发现的！”
泰德从尸体中扒出监狱的钥匙，回头一看只见郝宁愣在原地，顿时心中有些不满。
“嗯，我知道了！”
郝宁被他这么一喊，顿时回过神来，什么都没说地走向牢房大门的方向。
泰德也没在意，以为郝宁被他刚刚杀人的动作吓到了，两三步就跟了上去。
郝宁心中却没有想到这个五大三粗的家伙竟然是一个盗贼，而且是一个20级以上的黑铁阶盗贼，跟他这么一比，郝宁只能算是一个刚学会偷窃的小屁孩。
两人快步走到通道尽头的监狱大门，泰德将手中的一连串钥匙全都尝试了一遍，但是却没有一把钥匙能够
此时郝宁有些后悔帮泰德着盗贼之匙要50购买点数，但现在的他根本买不起。
虽然两人刚刚的动静已经尽量压制到最小，但是始终还是被一个醒来的犯人发现了，就像骨牌效应一般蔓延，越来越多犯人醒来对着通道外的郝宁呼唤着。
“也放我出去吧！求你了，求你了！”
“有人要越狱？求你了，帮我
…………
“这些该死的家伙，都别吵！我这就帮你
本来因为开不了监狱大门就非常烦躁，结果这么一闹，顿时泰德脸上浮现出一丝不快。他极为不耐烦地朝吵杂犯人说着，必须安抚他们，不然这么大的动静，正常人都会知道监狱出事了。
就在泰德决定给其余犯人去开锁时，郝宁觉得应该还有钥匙遗漏在尸体中，于是决定前往狱卒威尔的尸体上再搜查一次。
当郝宁再次回到原地，就发现地上的尸体似乎有些不对劲，但又说不出来哪里不对。
威尔的尸体躺在血泊中，脸色狰狞无比，就像是一只前来索命的厉鬼。

血腥味不断钻进郝宁的鼻子，浓烈刺鼻的味道令他忍不住一手捂住鼻子，一手往威尔的口袋摸去。
没有？郝宁发现威尔口袋中根本没有钥匙，而且在这个过程中，他总是感觉那双空洞的双眼始终在盯着他看，郝宁心中涌出一个惊骇的念头，难道尸变了？
不，不可能，亡灵生物不可能就这么简单出现的。郝宁随即把这个荒唐的念头甩出脑外，忽然他的手掌好像摸到了什么，顺手摸出来一看，是一颗暗红色的小石头。
“这…………这是……怨灵石！”
郝宁惊疑不定地看着手中的小石头，这颗石头非常像以前玩游戏那时候的怨灵石。
怨灵石在游戏中几乎说是最受亡灵法师欢迎的材料，因为能够以它为原型制造让亡灵生物进阶的物品。
在游戏中每种生物或者特殊灵魂体都是以一到九星来体现珍贵程度，星数每增加一颗都会变得强大很多，一旦到达九星那就简直可以跟神媲美！
进阶不同于升级，就算把等级升满了，也很难突破这个阶级。除了某些可自行进化的生物，大多数生物和特殊灵魂体的阶级都固定了，都只能靠珍贵的进阶物品来进化。
“这里不是游戏，这尸体该不会……发生尸变吧？”
郝宁心中还有一个忧虑，这些亡灵魔法材料一直都很诡异，而且这里又不是游戏，就连他也不知道会不会发生变异。
此时在他眼中，威尔的尸体变得越来越诡异，那双眼睛似乎无时无刻都在盯着自己。
啪嗒！一声轻微的响声在威尔的身体中发出，顿时郝宁被吓了一跳，踉跄地后退两步。一只老鼠在从尸体腋下转出，钻动期间，尸体那身盔甲不停地响动着。
原来只是老鼠，经过这么一吓，郝宁发现刚刚那阵诡异仿佛消失得一干二净。再次望去那具尸体却变得平平无奇，就像没有了灵魂。
不对，尸体怎么可能有灵魂！郝宁摇摇头往回走去，看着手中这暗红色的小石子，这石头也许能够兑换不少的购买点数吧！不过现在他没有立即兑换，而是往大门出走去。
当郝宁回到监狱大门处，本来就不大的通道此时变得十分拥挤。
放眼望去，大门附近竟然聚集了三十多人，几乎将整条通道挤满。
content_en:
Chapter 3 Prison Break in Progress
Suddenly, Ted's questioning voice came from Hao Ning's side. He was shocked and quickly put away the key in his hand.
"I...I just can't sleep and want to walk around!" Looking back, he saw Ted standing quietly behind him, staring closely at the key in his hand.
"You are lying! I have been paying attention to you since noon, including your magical magic props. There is no magic fluctuation at all when you use them, and you can actually cover up the fluctuations so well."
"Although I don't know what magic props you used, I am certain that you want to escape from this prison. If I make any noise, the soldiers outside will definitely notice what's going on inside, right? For example, the whole prison will be in trouble."
Ted's rough face was still very serious when he spoke, which made Hao Ning unable to see anything from his face.
"Our interests don't conflict, right? Besides, I'm a thief and I'm very good at escape routes!"
He was right, those knights were not something Hao Ning could deal with. A soldier who could become a knight should also have the strength of the black iron level!
People in this world can be divided into bronze, black iron, silver, and gold. If faced with a black iron knight, not to mention three, even one can kill Hao Ning easily.
"This... okay! I want to escape from prison! Do you want me to take you out too? No, this is impossible, you can't run fast at all!"
Hao Ning sighed slightly. Faced with his threat, Hao Ning had no choice but to agree to take him away. Otherwise, if there was a fuss, he would not face a jailer, but an endless city guard.
At this time, a strange smile appeared on Ted's rough face, and it disappeared in a flash.
"Haha! The thing you opened the door just now must be a magic item, right? I just want you to help me
He turned around and revealed the iron lock on the chain behind him. It was a lock engraved with runes and was usually used to lock important prisoners.
"Gold coins! "
The moment he heard the gold coins, Hao Ning felt as if he could hardly breathe. His body seemed to have an endless desire for gold coins.
Hao Ning couldn't help but curse in his heart, Damn it, this body is like a damn miser, why does he feel like he's about to die when he hears gold coins.
"Okay... okay! But I don't guarantee success. "
Hao Ning pointed the Thief's Key to the lock as he had just done, and whispered softly: "Use the Thief's Key! "
The whole cell seemed extremely quiet, and the key in his hand didn't react at all. Just when Hao Ning thought the key was useless, there was a burst of warmth from the key, and the lock on Ted's body automatically fell off to the ground.
Bang! The key exploded from his hand!
"Ah! "Hao Ning was also shocked. He didn't expect the key to explode like a firecracker. Fortunately, his attributes had been improved, otherwise his hand would have been injured by that blow.
"Why did this key explode? There is obviously another chance to use it! "Hao Ning looked at the key fragments in his hand in confusion.
"Dang! Dang Dang Dang! "Ted suddenly threw the chains on his body to the ground, "Great! This damn chain actually blocks all my power! "
"Okay, I will pay you when you get out. Now that you are ready to escape from prison, tell me your plan? "
"Now that you have joined, my plan will change..."
…………
Will at the end of the passage heard the sound of steel knocking from the cell, which seemed to be caused by the cell where the two new guys were.
What on earth are these damn guys doing at night! Hum! Let you see how powerful I am Will!
He put on his standard long sword and walked towards the passage. He was determined to teach this new guy a lesson and let him understand the rules here.
"Damn it! Damn youWhat on earth is this guy doing..."
Oh my god, Will couldn't believe what he was seeing!
In the dark cell, the disgusting thief prisoner was lying on the ground without knowing whether he was alive or dead, and the prisoner with chains all over his body was missing! Cold sweat kept breaking out from his forehead. If the prisoner escaped from this cell, there was no doubt that Will himself would be sent to the guillotine.
But as a soldier, Will did not forget the lessons learned on the battlefield. He drew out the standard sword from his waist and scanned the surroundings with vigilant eyes. Because Will is sure that the prisoner has never left this place!
"Are you looking for me? "
An eerie voice came from behind Will, like the call of the dead.
A huge force hit Will, and with a pop, he only felt a pain on his neck, and the blood mist occupied his sight. There was endless fear in his eyes. He wanted to speak, but there seemed to be a hole in his throat, and only a hoarse roar came out of his mouth.
Will clutched his throat unwillingly, blood gushing out uncontrollably, his eyes gradually began to dim, and he fell soft to the ground with a plop. He stared at Ted with resentful eyes. He was unwilling to give in. He wanted to take revenge on these two people. He wanted these two people to never escape from this prison.
A figure slowly emerged from his side, casually shaking away the blood from the dagger in his hand.
That was the disappearing Ted, who managed to get rid of the jailer so easily without attracting any attention.
Hao Ning, who was lying dead not far away, also stood up and looked at the unwilling corpse on the ground with complicated eyes.
It seems that he still thinks of killing too simply. This is not a game, and what is being killed is not a bunch of data. However, Hao Ning is about to face an unknown world. In the future, killing is inevitable.
Will I really be able to do it by then? Hao Ning couldn't help but look at his slightly trembling hands.
"Hi! It's time to go, if you keep dragging it like this, someone will find out! "
Ted took out the prison key from the body. When he looked back, he saw Hao Ning frozen in place, and he suddenly felt dissatisfied.
"Well, I know! "
Hao Ning came to his senses when he shouted like this, and walked towards the cell door without saying anything.
Ted didn't pay attention, thinking that Hao Ning was frightened by the murder he had just done, so he followed him in two or three steps.
Hao Ning did not expect that this tall and thick guy turned out to be a thief, and a black iron-level thief above level 20. Compared with him, Hao Ning could only be regarded as a kid who had just learned to steal.
The two walked quickly to the prison door at the end of the passage. Ted tried all the keys in his hand, but none of them could
At this time, Hao Ning regretted helping Ted carry the Thief's Key and asked for 50 purchase points, but he couldn't afford it now.
Although the movement between the two men had been suppressed to a minimum, it was still discovered by a prisoner who woke up. It spread like a domino effect. More and more prisoners woke up and called to Hao Ning outside the passage.
"Let me out too! Please, please! "
"Someone wants to escape from prison? please, help me
…………
"These damn guys, don't make any noise! I'll help you right now
Ted was originally very irritated because he couldn't open the prison door, but when this happened, a trace of displeasure suddenly appeared on Ted's face. He spoke to the noisy prisoners extremely impatiently, saying that they must be appeased, otherwise normal people would know something was wrong in the prison due to such a loud noise.
Just when Ted decided to unlock the remaining prisoners, Hao Ning felt that there should be a key missing in the body, so he decided to search the body of jailer Will again.
When Hao Ning returned to the place again, he found that something seemed wrong with the body on the ground, but he couldn't tell what was wrong.
Will's body was lying in a pool of blood, with a hideous face, likeIt was a fierce ghost that came to seek life.
The smell of blood kept getting into Hao Ning's nose, and the strong and pungent smell made him couldn't help but cover his nose with one hand and touch into Will's pocket with the other.
No? Hao Ning discovered that there was no key in Will's pocket, and in the process, he always felt that those empty eyes were always staring at him. A horrifying thought came to Hao Ning's heart, could the corpse have changed?
No, it's impossible, undead creatures can't appear so easily. Hao Ning immediately put this ridiculous idea out of his mind. Suddenly his palm seemed to touch something. He took it out and saw that it was a small dark red stone.
"This...this is...the resentful spirit stone!"
Hao Ning looked at the small stone in his hand in surprise. This stone was very similar to the Wraith Stone from when he was playing games.
Wraith Stone is almost the most popular material for necromancers in the game, because it can be used as a prototype to create items that allow undead creatures to advance.
In the game, each creature or special soul body has one to nine stars to reflect its preciousness. Every time the number of stars increases, it will become much more powerful. Once it reaches nine stars, it will be comparable to gods!
Advancement is different from upgrading. Even if the level is fully upgraded, it will be difficult to break through this level. Except for some creatures that can evolve on their own, most creatures and special souls have fixed levels, and they can only evolve through precious advanced items.
"This is not a game. Is this corpse... transformed into a corpse?"
Hao Ning still has a worry in his heart. These undead magic materials have always been weird, and this is not a game. Even he doesn't know whether it will mutate.
At this time, in his eyes, Will's body became more and more strange, and those eyes seemed to be staring at him all the time.
Snap! A slight sound came from Will's body, and Hao Ning was startled and staggered back two steps. A mouse was turning out from the armpit of the corpse. As it moved, the armor of the corpse kept making noises.
It turned out to be just a mouse. After such a scare, Hao Ning found that the weirdness just now seemed to have completely disappeared. Looking at the body again, it became ordinary, as if it had no soul.
No, how could a corpse have a soul! Hao Ning shook his head and walked back, looking at the dark red pebble in his hand. This pebble might be able to be exchanged for a lot of purchase points! But now he did not redeem it immediately, but walked out of the gate.
When Hao Ning returned to the prison gate, the originally small passage became very crowded.
Looking around, there were more than thirty people gathered near the gate, almost filling the entire passage.
